story_text: As a user, I want to be blocked from logging in if my account is locked so that security is enforced.

positive.title: Validate Blocked login attempt when account is locked
steps: 2. Enter valid credentials for a locked account.
positive.expected_result: User is blocked from logging in and an appropriate error message is displayed.

positive.title: Ensure account lockout after multiple failed login attempts
steps: 2. Enter invalid credentials multiple times (e.g., 5 times).
3. Attempt to log in with valid credentials after lockout.
positive.expected_result: After multiple failed attempts, the account is locked and the user is blocked from logging in even with valid credentials.

positive.title: Display account locked error message on login attempt
steps: 2. Enter valid credentials for a locked account.
positive.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the account is locked.

positive.title: Redirect locked user to account recovery or support page
steps: 2. Enter valid credentials for a locked account.
positive.expected_result: The user is redirected to the account recovery or support page.

negative.title: Allow login for a locked account
steps: 2. Enter valid credentials for a locked account.
negative.expected_result: User is allowed to log in successfully, which indicates a failure in enforcing account lockout.

negative.title: Fail to lock account after multiple failed login attempts
steps: 2. Enter invalid credentials multiple times (e.g., 5 times).
3. Attempt to log in with valid credentials after supposed lockout.
negative.expected_result: The account is not locked, and the user is allowed to log in with valid credentials.

negative.title: No error message displayed for locked account login attempt
steps: 2. Enter valid credentials for a locked account.
negative.expected_result: No error message is displayed, indicating a failure in providing feedback about the locked account.

negative.title: Locked user is not redirected to account recovery or support page
steps: 2. Enter valid credentials for a locked account.
negative.expected_result: The user is not redirected to the account recovery or support page.

edge.title: Attempt Login directly after account lockout
steps: 1. Navigate to the login page immediately after triggering account lockout.
2. Enter valid credentials for the locked account.
edge.expected_result: User is blocked from logging in and an appropriate error message is displayed, even immediately after lockout.

edge.title: Attempt Login with recently unlocked account
steps: 1. Navigate to the login page after an account has been unlocked.
2. Enter valid credentials for the recently unlocked account.
edge.expected_result: User is allowed to log in with valid credentials for the recently unlocked account.

edge.title: Attempt Login with account locked during active session login attempt
steps: 2. Enter valid credentials for an account that gets locked during the login attempt.
edge.expected_result: User is logged out and blocked from logging in, with an appropriate error message displayed.
